prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE standalone original small raster printmaking ornament for a masthead. Create only the illustration; no website, no screenshot, no interface, no mockup.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background with actual alpha. All empty areas including gaps inside the composition must be transparent. No paper surface, no background rectangle, no drawn checkerboard. No texture or speckle in empty background.
Style/medium: sophisticated retro drypoint, fine engraving and restrained risograph ink. A humanistic book ornament with a subtle mathematical sensibility. Fine printed lines, sparse authentic ink breaks within marks, delicate and calm. Enough clarity to read when displayed at 290 by 145 pixels.
Composition/framing: approximately 2:1 landscape canvas. One low, wide, optically centered composition with asymmetrical balance. All marks comfortably within margins; nothing clipped. Plenty of fully transparent negative space. Ink should occupy only a small fraction of the canvas.
Avoid: all text, lettering, numerals, captions, watermarks, logos, borders, frames, paper rectangles, all-over noise, shadows, 3D, glossy effects, hardware, chips, circuits, literal graphs or axes, planetary motifs, landscape painting.
Primary request: irregular nested OPEN contour rings, five or six thin elongated contours of slightly different organic kidney-like shapes. Their centers are offset so the nested contours quietly bunch on one end and open apart on the other, suggesting an abstract organic mathematical field. Include generous breaks in every contour so none forms a closed ring; a wide low horizontal silhouette. Sparse charcoal ink and only one tiny muted indigo passage along a short arc. The form is a single irregular nested field, not separate overlapping ellipses, not an atom symbol, not topography or a labeled map. No terrain, trees, hills, or concentric perfect circles.
